prompt: Translate between package names and the source directories they live in. Complete the three PackageDirectoryMapper methods and run the tests.
explanation: The javac rule is simply that package names and directory names are the same information written two ways, so both conversions are one replace() call. The interesting part is the edge cases: the default package is an empty name and an empty path, and a directory string may carry slashes that a package name must not. Building sourcePathFor on top of toDirectory keeps the empty-package special case in one place instead of two.
hints: replace('.', '/') and replace('/', '.') do the conversions; the rest of the work is handling the edges.
Strip leading and trailing slashes before converting a directory, or you will get empty segments like ".com.example.".
Let sourcePathFor call toDirectory and add the separator only when the directory is not empty.
